name: Umbrella and Excess Underlying Check
summary: Check the underlying policies and asset context an umbrella placement depends on.

spec.user: A household or business considering umbrella or excess coverage.
inputData: Underlying policies in force and their limits
authoritativeSources: Published umbrella form underlying-limit requirements, cited by form and edition
spec.privacyBoundary: No net worth figure, no account information, no addresses. Bands only.
decisionRules: Underlying limit requirements come from a cited form, never from a rule of thumb.

This tool never states that a risk is eligible, ineligible, standard market, non-admitted, FAIR Plan eligible, bound, or uninsurable. It shows the published pathway criteria and names who actually decides, which is the insurer.
spec.uncertainty: Underlying requirements vary by insurer and by form, and a gap in an underlying limit can leave the insured personally exposed.
spec.output: A printable underlying-limit worksheet with the gaps identified.
exportFormat: PDF via the browser print dialog
spec.updateCadence: Reviewed at least every 180 days, and immediately when a cited source changes.
